profile: 60 paid journeys/s for 60 s; two synchronized generator processes at 30/s each, 250 in-flight and 250 HTTP connections per process; disjoint shows/viewers; four API replicas and four Kafka consumers; one callback/payment; no retries
transport_phase_p95_ms_mode: worst shard p95, not a combined percentile
interpretation: The two-process generator reduced worst-shard pre-send tails versus the single-process 60/s trace but still dropped 891 scheduled journeys. It also exposed DB pool rejections and Kafka/consumer backlog. This is a failed one-minute synthetic stage, not evidence of sustained 60/s capacity. Every successfully paid order eventually received one ticket; eight unpaid orders expired.
